title: The Representation of the People Act, 1950
department: Ministry of Law and Justice, Legislative Department
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act governs allocation and delimitation of seats, electoral rolls and qualifications of voters for elections to Parliament and State Legislatures.

title: The Representation of the People Act, 1951
department: Ministry of Law and Justice, Legislative Department
sourceNote: Official India Code. The Act governs conduct of elections to Parliament and State Legislatures, qualifications/disqualifications, corrupt practices, offences and election disputes.
